/about.title: About | STATIC FORM
/about.description: STATIC FORM is an independent label based in Porto. Small runs, twice a year, in grey, bone and black.
p: STATIC FORM is an independent label based in Porto. We make a small number of pieces twice a year, in grey, bone and black, and we show them the way we would want to see them: one at a time.
THE STUDIO / PORTO / CUTTING TABLE, PATTERN WALL AND RAIL
Heavy, uneven, slightly rough. We keep the hand of the cloth and do not smooth it out.
A dense cotton that holds a crease and a collar without much help.
Spun in Peru, knitted in a small mill north of Porto on a coarse gauge.
Tanned slowly with bark. It darkens at the folds and keeps the marks.
Each piece is cut in a run of 120 to 400. When a size is gone, it is gone.
Coats in Porto, knit in Guimarães, shirts in Barcelos. We visit each of them before every season.
Unsold pieces go to the archive, not to a discount. The price you see is the price all year.
Send any STATIC FORM piece back to the studio. We mend seams, buttons and hems at cost.
Showroom by appointment, Tuesday to Friday, 11:00 to 18:00
